independent_source.source_retrieval: landing_page_verified; original file stream 403; no outcome fitted
independent_source.prior_art: Species and individual phenological synchrony predicts egg placement already demonstrated in the original 2018 study.

chocho_bridge.interpretation: independent global static reference only; zero empirical local colonization/fitness validation

nontrivial_scientific_question: At equal contemporaneous host supply, host identity, site and seasonal effort, does staggering of the suitable reproductive windows across host species predict independently observed egg placement and its temporal continuity in held-out site-years?
candidate_outcome: egg count per examined host plant with observed zero counts and effort denominator; not mechanically calculated opportunity
primary_unit: site-year-week or plant observation nested within site-year cluster

require: source column names and exact stage codebook
zero-egg hosts as well as egg-positive hosts
documented sampling denominator/exposure per host and date
identifiable regions and site-year repeat units
at least 2 host species on overlapping surveyed dates
independent or explicitly limited definition of flight period

primary_model.baseline: observed eggs given total contemporaneous plant availability, site/region, season and host taxon
primary_model.increment: prespecified cross-host stage/phenology dispersion, conditional on contemporaneously stage-suitable plant abundance
primary_model.contrast: out-of-sample site-year-blocked predictive log score; improvement from increment beyond baseline
primary_model.biological_endpoint: observed egg counts; do not infer larval survival

secondary_checks: stage-code threshold fixed before outcome model and if not definable label exploratory
site-year block bootstrap, not plant-row bootstrap
stop_rules: Original raw file inaccessible or incomplete -> report SOURCE_ACCESS_BLOCKED
No explicit zero-egg sampled plants -> no egg-selection probability
Phenology codebook cannot be mapped without egg outcomes -> stop confirmatory effect
No independent adult-flight windows -> restrict inference to surveyed egg dates
Not enough independent site-year clusters or too little phenological variation -> no stable inference
No held-out predictive improvement or one region drives all signs -> no insurance claim
Do not infer adult survival, demographic rescue, genetic host shifting, or alien-host causal effects
future_experiment: crossed host-stage synchrony × introduced-host removal with matched supply and site/population replication, maternal choices and individual eclosion outcomes
submission_isolation: do not change main, paper/ecological-resource-homogenization-v01 or PR #38
